comment.en: The University of Coimbra is the oldest university in Portugal and one of the oldest in the world. A comprehensive institution, it combines study, teaching, research and innovation across the full range of disciplines, and over its long history has shaped Coimbra into a true university city. Through research, teaching and services to the community, it contributes to economic and social development, environmental protection and social justice.

definition.en:
The University of Coimbra (UC) is the oldest university in Portugal and one of the oldest in the world, with a history reaching back to the century that followed the founding of Portugal itself. It has spread across the city, shaping Coimbra into a university city whose historic university buildings are listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site.

UC is a comprehensive institution devoted to the creation, critical analysis, transfer and dissemination of culture, science and technology, combining study, teaching, research and innovation across the full range of disciplines.

Through research, teaching and services to the community, it contributes to economic and social development, environmental protection, the promotion of social justice and an informed and responsible society.

Within the EC2U Alliance, it leads the work package on sustainable cities and communities (SDG 11) and co-leads the one on good health and well-being (SDG 3).

comment.en: Alexandru Ioan Cuza University of Iași is the oldest higher education institution in Romania and consistently ranks among the country’s leading universities for research, education and institutional transparency. Its 15 faculties offer bachelor, master and doctoral programmes, including degrees taught in English and French, and it cooperates with more than 650 universities worldwide through international networks and agreements.

definition.en:
Alexandru Ioan Cuza University of Iași (UAIC) is the oldest higher education institution in Romania and consistently ranks among the country’s leading universities for research, education and institutional transparency.

Its 15 faculties span the humanities, social, natural and exact sciences, economics, law and theology, offering programmes at bachelor, master and doctoral level, including degrees taught in English and French.

The university cooperates with more than 650 universities worldwide and is a member of the Coimbra Group, the European University Association, the Utrecht Network, the International Association of Universities, the Agence universitaire de la Francophonie and the Network of Francophone Universities, which support mobility and joint academic, research and strategic programmes.

Within the EC2U Alliance, it leads the work package on good health and well-being (SDG 3) and co-leads the one on quality education (SDG 4).

comment.en: Friedrich Schiller University Jena is one of the oldest universities in Germany. Once the centre of German philosophical thought, it is today a broad-based, research-intensive university recognised for excellence in research and teaching, with students from more than 110 countries. Together with partners from science, industry, civil society and culture, it pursues discovery-based research on pressing global challenges.

definition.en:
Friedrich Schiller University Jena is one of the oldest universities in Germany. Once the centre of German philosophical thought, it is today a broad-based, research-intensive university with a global reach and an international community of undergraduate and postgraduate students from more than 110 countries.

The university is recognised for excellence in research and teaching, for its international reputation and for a strong culture of collaboration, attracting scientists, scholars and students from around the world across every discipline it offers.

Together with partners from science, industry, civil society and culture, it pursues innovative, discovery-based research on today’s pressing global issues while preparing for the challenges of tomorrow.

Within the EC2U Alliance, it leads the work package on peace, justice and strong institutions (SDG 16) and co-leads the one on sustainable cities and communities (SDG 11).

comment.en: Johannes Kepler University Linz (JKU), named after the astronomer who lived and worked in the city, offers programmes in law, business and economics, social sciences, engineering, natural sciences and medicine. Its research focuses on fields such as artificial intelligence, medical technology, sustainable polymers and digitalisation, with attention to social and environmental impact, and it aims to become climate-neutral by 2030.

definition.en:
Johannes Kepler University Linz (JKU), named after the astronomer who lived and worked in the city, offers higher education in law, business and economics, social sciences, engineering, natural sciences and medicine on its campus in Linz.

Its research spans fields such as artificial intelligence, medical technology, sustainable polymers and digitalisation, pursued with attention to their social impact and to the welfare of people and the environment.

The university involves its students in research that actively shapes the future, works closely with partners from industry and society in Upper Austria and beyond, and has set itself the goal of becoming a climate-neutral university by 2030.

Within the EC2U Alliance, it leads the work package on lifelong careers and co-leads the one on the EC2U Innovation Hub, which connects the EC2U universities with innovation ecosystems in their cities and regions.

comment.en: The University of Pavia is one of the oldest academic institutions in the world and was, until the 20th century, the only university of Lombardy. A comprehensive university with 18 departments, it covers science, engineering, life sciences, humanities and social sciences from bachelor to doctoral level, and is distinguished by its network of historic university colleges and over 700 international partnerships.

definition.en:
The University of Pavia (UNIPV) is one of the oldest academic institutions in the world and, until the 20th century, was the only university in the Milan area and in Lombardy.

It is a comprehensive university covering science and technology, engineering, life sciences, humanities and social sciences, with 18 departments offering programmes from bachelor to doctoral level and more than 900 professors and researchers.

Its students benefit from a distinctive network of university colleges, among them the historic Collegio Ghislieri and Collegio Borromeo, offering additional learning opportunities and community life. With over 700 international partnerships, the university promotes interdisciplinary collaboration, innovation, global mobility and engagement with society.

Within the EC2U Alliance, it leads the work package on the Digital EC2U Alliance, which develops shared digital services such as the European Student Card, digital credentials and the EC2U Knowledge Hub, and co-leads those on peace, justice and strong institutions (SDG 16) and on lifelong careers.

comment.en: Founded by Pope Eugene IV and confirmed by King Charles VII, the University of Poitiers is one of the oldest universities in France. A multidisciplinary university with sites in Poitiers, Angoulême, Niort and Châtellerault, it offers more than 200 bachelor, master and doctoral programmes, is committed to accessibility and sustainability, and is a member of the Coimbra Group and the Aliénor d’Aquitaine University Alliance.

definition.en:
Founded by Pope Eugene IV and confirmed by King Charles VII, the University of Poitiers is one of the oldest and most renowned universities in France and a long-standing cornerstone of higher education and research in the region.

A multidisciplinary university with sites in Poitiers, Angoulême, Niort and Châtellerault, it offers more than 200 programmes at bachelor, master and doctoral level and employs over 3,000 staff in teaching, research and administration.

The university is committed to accessibility, sustainability and international cooperation, and is a member of the Coimbra Group, a network of long-established European universities, and of the Aliénor d’Aquitaine University Alliance.

The University of Poitiers coordinates the EC2U Alliance, leading the work packages on its coordination, governance and expansion and on impact and dissemination, which carries EC2U results to its communities and beyond.

comment.en: The University of Salamanca is one of the three oldest universities in Europe and the alma mater of nearly all the historical universities of Latin America. The reference university of Castile and León, it hosts a wide range of faculties and research institutes across the sciences and the arts, is renowned for its Spanish courses for international students, and holds Campus of International Excellence status.

definition.en:
The University of Salamanca (USAL) is one of the three oldest universities in Europe. It is the reference university of Castile and León and beyond, and the alma mater of nearly all the historical universities of Latin America.

The university hosts a wide range of faculties and research institutes across the sciences and the arts, is renowned for its Spanish courses for international students, and was awarded Campus of International Excellence status in 2011.

Its USAL30 Strategy, a participatory roadmap built around nine strategic priorities, aims at high-quality education, creativity and ethical thinking, and social transformation through research and innovation, strengthening the connection between heritage and innovation.

Within the EC2U Alliance, it leads the work packages on quality education (SDG 4) and on the EC2U Innovation Hub, which connects the EC2U universities with innovation ecosystems in their cities and regions.

comment.en: Founded on the initiative of citizens, with academic traditions in the city dating back to 1640, the University of Turku is one of the leading research universities in Finland. It offers study and research opportunities in eight faculties and four independent units, on campuses in Turku, Pori and Rauma, and its multidisciplinary research spans digitalisation, health, learning, cultural memory and sustainability.

definition.en:
Founded on the initiative of citizens, with the support of more than 22,000 donors, and with academic traditions in the city dating back to 1640, the University of Turku (UTU) is one of the leading research universities in Finland.

It offers study and research opportunities in eight faculties and four independent units, on campuses in Turku, Pori and Rauma. Its main campus lies in the historic centre of Turku.

Its multidisciplinary research themes include new technologies and digitalisation; health, diagnostics and drug development; children, young people and learning; cultural memory and social change; and biodiversity and sustainability. It is an active regional developer and takes part in university networks in Europe, China, Africa and the Arctic.

Within the EC2U Alliance, it leads the work package on an inclusive, engaged and mobile EC2U community and co-leads the one on the Digital EC2U Alliance, which develops shared digital services for mobility, credentials and innovative digital pedagogy.

comment.en: Umeå University is a comprehensive university and one of the largest higher education institutions in Sweden, with education and research across all disciplinary domains and the arts. The Nobel Prize-winning CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing tool was discovered there, and the university hosts the highly ranked Umeå Institute of Design, an Arctic Research Centre and Várdduo, Sweden’s only centre for Sámi and Indigenous research.

definition.en:
Umeå University is a comprehensive university and one of the largest higher education institutions in Sweden, offering education and research across all disciplinary domains and the arts. The CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing tool, recognised with the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, was discovered there.

Campus Umeå and the Umeå Arts Campus lie close to the city centre and next to one of Sweden’s largest university hospitals, and education is also provided in Skellefteå, Örnsköldsvik, Lycksele and Kiruna. Its schools include the Umeå Institute of Design, the School of Business, Economics and Law, and the School of Architecture.

It is one of Sweden’s national sports universities and hosts an internationally leading Arctic Research Centre and Várdduo, Sweden’s only centre for Sámi and Indigenous research.

Through long-term collaboration with organisations, industry and other universities, it helps northern Sweden become a knowledge region, studying a society in transition.
